feature_definition: Statistics on frozen cropped input-grid logits clipped to [-20,20]; 3x3 inner boundary including image border; empty region statistics zero; base five features follow existing original-grid export; each multi-action row adds its numeric threshold as action descriptor
selection: Same 1500/500 train2017 split. Same matched identities and all success/failure groups. Max target repairs under frozen RCMC damage budget, then fewer damages, more overall repairs, summed IoU, higher cutoff. Multi-action rows have equal 1/K weight per original instance. Same total 300 seven-leaf trees in all variants. No selection using val results.
scope: Pilot on fixed matched slots only; not COCO AP, not new blind confirmation. Extract only matched objects to minimize runtime. Single seed, no tree or feature retuning. GT creates labels and verifies parity only; all model inputs are prediction derived.
advance_rule: A candidate must Pareto improve target repair versus BOTH single_shape and frozen RCMC on selection at frozen policies. Then freeze and proceed to all-prediction AP evaluation; selection is not independent proof. If none passes stop this pilot without searching.
